# Split Account Hub tests by user flow while keeping shared fixtures in head.js

The human refactor moves manual configuration and sync-account discovery into dedicated browser_accountHubManualConfig.js and browser_accountHubSyncAccounts.js files. Current browser.toml still registers those flow names while head.js holds MailServices and fake server helpers. This is a local filename/ownership pattern: keep flow-specific setup and assertions in the flow file, and shared helpers in head.js. It does not establish one naming convention for every Thunderbird test directory. Static source and test inspection only. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending.

Scope: Account Hub test structure.
